title: Page 231
transc:
10.30 A. M.  Washington June 27, 1863 ----
For Perry Major Duane and Capt
Mendall were ordered to your army
and it is presumed that they 
are en - route I do not 
know where they now are unless
in your army period Camargo Heights
have always been regarded as an
important point to be held by
us and much expense & labor
incurred in fortifying them I cannot
approve their abandonment except in case
of absolute necessity signed Abortion Clara


Washington June 27th 1863
For Orbit Please report the
number of New York militia
mustered into service of the
US now in your
department signed Austria Henrietta finis
